class PendingExit102A { function __destruct() { echo 'PENDING|'; } }
class OldExit102A {
    function make($capture) { return function (&$first, &$second) use ($capture) { echo 'BAD-BODY|'; try { yield $capture; } finally { echo 'BAD-GEN-FIN|'; } }; }
    function __destruct() { echo 'OLD|'; }
}
class MakerExit102A { function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; } }
function NewMaker102A() { global $weakMaker; $value = new MakerExit102A(); $weakMaker = WeakReference::create($value); return $value; }
function NewPrefix102A() { global $weakPrefix; $value = new PrefixExit102A(); $weakPrefix = WeakReference::create($value); return $value; }
function NewPending102A() { global $weakPending; $value = new PendingExit102A(); $weakPending = WeakReference::create($value); return $value; }
function Quiet102A($severity, $message) { echo 'BAD-HANDLER|'; return true; }
function Warn102A($severity, $message) {
    global $warnings, $source;
    $warnings = $warnings + 1; echo 'WARN|', $warnings, '|';
    if ($warnings === 1) { return true; }
    $source = null; exit(23);
}
function Shutdown102A() {
    global $weakSource, $weakOld, $weakMaker, $weakPrefix, $weakPending, $weakCapture, $warnings;
    $previous = set_error_handler('Quiet102A');
    echo 'SHUT|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakPrefix->get() === null, '|', $weakPending->get() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof MakerExit102A, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof CaptureExit102A, '|', $warnings === 2, '|', $previous === 'Warn102A', '|';
    restore_error_handler();
}
$capture = new CaptureExit102A(); $weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture);
$old = new OldExit102A(); $weakOld = WeakReference::create($old);
$source = $old->make($capture); $weakSource = WeakReference::create($source); unset($old, $capture);
$generator = null; $warnings = 0; set_error_handler('Warn102A'); register_shutdown_function('Shutdown102A');
echo 'CALL|';
try { $generator = $source->call(NewMaker102A(), NewPrefix102A(), NewPending102A()); echo 'BAD-CREATED|'; }
catch (Throwable $caught) { echo 'BAD-CATCH|'; }
finally { echo 'BAD-CALLER-FIN|'; }
echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
